_doc: Collar cross at 144 px (DESIGN.md 3 row 1, revision 3): a 5 x 5 cross, G1 lit arms, G3 on the shade side, a G0 glint where the arms cross, on a 1 px I3 backing (gold on white is only 1.13:1). Authored pixels, stamped by tools/pixel-pipeline/glyphs.py on the projected centre of the 3D pendant; mirrored when the chest faces screen-left. o = I3 backing, g = G1, h = G3, s = G0.
